facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: There was not documentation of the annual written CPSC certification. Note: This was completed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Photo Identification: Photo identification  was not in the two personnel records evaluated. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §747.901(7))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Permitted Before April 25, 2021 & No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing by May 25, 2021: Parents have not been notified in writing the operation does not have current liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Permitted Before April 25, 2021 & No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing by May 25, 2021 (26 TAC §747.213(b))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Annual Training-counted in ratio more than 10 times in a training year: The assistant caregiver did not receive 24 clock hours of training for the November 2021-November 2022 training year. The assistant caregiver will need to obtain make-up training hours. The make-up training hours will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Annual Training-counted in ratio more than 10 times in a training year (26 TAC §747.1305(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Record Upon Admission: The immunization records for two children was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Notarized affidavits were not in the two personnel files evalauted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the three children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A child under the age of 2 was watching a televison program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not state the following information:  1. How children under 2 or children that need assistance will be evacuated  2. The name and address of the alternate shelter  3. How children will be accounted for
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were uncovered outlets in the are used by children. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not include the following information:  1. How you will communicate with local authorities, parents or Child Care Regulation.  2. The emergency telephone number on file with Child Care Regulation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how the folloiwing informaiton will be evacauted:   1. Parent and emergency contact telephone numbers  2. Authorization for emergency care   3. The attendance records
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation (26 TAC §747.5003(3))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver did not receive 30 clock hours of annual training for the November 2021-November 2022 training year. You will need to receoive make-up training hours that will not count towards the current traning year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be reunited with their parents once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan (26 TAC §747.5003(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational polices does not inform parents of the requirement for outdoor play and physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One out of three sheds outside did not have a lock.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when a lock was added to the door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: Vaccinations for the providers dog expired in May of 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extenguisher needle pointed to "empty."
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: While evaluating three childrens files, the following observations were made:    1. One child was missing an address for an emergency contact.   	NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the provider recieved an address for the emergency contact.     2. Two children were missing a health care provider statement.   3. One child was missing a hearing and vision test.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))
